Shrimp Penne Alfredo
By: Anonymous
Published: Tuesday, December 1, 2009 - 12:47am

Ingredients




1/2 pound uncooked penne pasta
2 pkg. (1.6 oz.) alfredo sauce
1 1/2 cups milk
1 teaspoon grated lemon peel
2 tablespoons butter
1/2 pound med. mushrooms, sliced
1 med. onion, chopped
2 lg. clove garlic, crushed
12 ounces fresh spinach
1 pound shrimp, shelled and drained
1/2 pound shredded Mozzarella
2 tablespoons grated Parmesan

Preparation

1 Preheat oven 350 degrees. Cook pasta and drain. Prepare alfredo sauce, using milk. Stir in lemon peel. Set aside. In large skillet, melt butter. Add mushrooms, onion, garlic. Saute. Stir in spinach. Cover. Cook until spinach wilts. Stir in shrimp. Cook 2 minutes. 2 Combine all ingredients in casserole dish. Bake for 30 minutes. Serves 4.
